title: Revv [Gated Esports Livestream]
tagline: Empowering Streamers to host exclusive livestreams for their top fans
description:
Revv's tokengated live stream feature allows streamers to quickly launch a stream where only holders of certain NFTs are allowed access

Streamers have the option of quickly going live or scheduling a future stream. This entire process, for both streamers and fans, is easily managed within Revv.
how_its_made:
Streamers will first issue a @POAP live on stream through Revv's main platform integration with Twitch and YouTube or airdrop it to followers/subscribers of their channel(s).

Streamers can then launch or schedule a private live stream, which will be powered by @Livepeer. Prior to entering the live stream, a user will verify ownership of the NFT. This will generate a unique URL for the fan. In the background, our platform will periodically check that no one else is entering the live stream with the same NFT or via link sharing. If this is detected, the offending party will be removed from the stream.
